lanes.summary: Checked write-time gating, contract alignment, commit history, classification discrepancies against the reader's rule, and the backfilled ledger records for PMAT-1366. Verified byte-for-byte exactness of the backfill edits and accurate O_APPEND linux write behaviours. A blocking issue was found where the branch commits lack a closing keyword (e.g., 'Fixes #1366'), which will strand the issue open. Two non-blocking classification discrepancies were noted for rows without units.

findings.claim: The commit messages do not contain a closing keyword.
findings.fix: Amend a commit message or the PR body to include 'Fixes #1366' or 'Closes #1366' so the issue is automatically closed upon merge.

findings.claim: Rows without a unit (measured or unmeasured) are flagged as schema violations by the Rust check rather than being classified as 'unmeasured' or excluded with reason 'no-unit' by the reader rule.
findings.fix: Non-blocking. The Rust check enforces a stricter schema validation than the reader gracefully handles. This is intentional as per the test 'estimate_ledger_check_flags_unit_less_rows_measured_or_not'.

lanes.summary: Review of branch PMAT-1366-estimate-ledger-unit (HEAD 42469eba8, base 441d198e7) confirms all 5 ticket requirements and review checks A-G pass. The writer is append-only with strict write-time gating, correct atomic stream_position line calculation, and zero byte-corruption or file/dir creation on refusal. The committed ledger diff inserts only the 'unit' key on L1-L18 (recoverable as turn on L1-L9 and L11-L14, unknown on L10 and L15-L18 from rows/receipts) and re-keys L17-L30 to 'paiml-mcp-agent-toolkit' without altering any other bytes. CLI arguments are collision-free (--exec-mode avoids global --mode), all 27 unit tests pass, contracts and falsifications are verified, and code complexity and safety checks pass.

findings.claim: classify_row maps any non-turn unit (including missing or null unit) to Err("unit-not-turn") instead of returning "no-unit" as estimate.sh does; however, check_line intercepts missing/null unit in row_violations before tally_row, reporting it as a schema violation in report.violations rather than an excluded row in report.excluded. Non-blocking.
findings.fix: Optional alignment: match unit with None => Err("no-unit"), Some("turn") => ..., Some(_) => Err("unit-not-turn"). Currently non-blocking because schema-validity gate intercepts unit-less rows first.

findings.claim: check_line's row_violations verifies ticket is a string (is_some_and(|v| v.is_string())) but does not check for blank strings (!is_blank), whereas the write gate gate_required_fields strictly enforces !is_blank for ticket at record time. Non-blocking.
findings.fix: In row_violations, check obj.get("ticket").and_then(|v| v.as_str()).map_or(false, |s| !is_blank(s)) to ensure committed text check matches write-time gate.

lanes.summary: Independent code review of branch PMAT-1366-estimate-ledger-unit (HEAD 42469eba8, base 441d198e7) for GitHub issue #1366. All 5 ticket requirements and review checklist items A through G have been verified with concrete evidence: the single gated append-only writer prevents partial writes, truncations, or reordering; reader classifications match paiml-implement rules; backfilled units are rigorously grounded in receipts and row text; CLI arguments avoid global collisions; contracts and falsification tests are fully aligned and green (27/27 tests pass); and no merge-blocking safety defects, unhandled unwraps, or complexity violations exist. Verdict: PASS.

findings.claim: append_row, gate_new_row, and gate_repo_split validate rows in-memory prior to any file or directory creation; refused rows exit with Err and leave the ledger and parent directory completely untouched.

Appends are performed using OpenOptions append(true) (O_APPEND) with a single write_all call, ensuring exact prefix preservation, no line overwrites, and proper handling of missing trailing newlines. stream_position accurately determines the 1-based line number on Linux even under concurrency.
check_ledger_text and classify_row faithfully reproduce the reader rules and reason strings (unit-not-turn, range-phase, no-unit, and unmeasured for null actuals) without any divergence.

All 30 rows in docs/audits/impl-estimates.jsonl conform to the single-key policy ('paiml-mcp-agent-toolkit') and correct unit attribution: turn for L1-L9 and L11-L14 (grounded in row text and receipts), and unknown for unmeasured/unrecoverable rows L10 and L15-L18. No other bytes were altered.
pmat work estimate record and check commands are fully reachable via CLI dispatch, and the --exec-mode flag cleanly avoids collision with the global --mode flag without shadowing or panics.
All 27 test cases in work_estimate_ledger_tests pass cleanly, contain non-vacuous assertions, and the committed ledger test verifies the real disk file.
The contract contracts/estimate-ledger-v1.yaml binds 6 valid proof obligations to existing functions and all 15 falsification test IDs to existing test definitions.
